roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.speaker: Islwyn
roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.text: You, you're the human that killed Tyras. Arianwyn told us about you.

roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.player: That's me. Could you take me to Arianwyn?

roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.speaker: Islwyn
roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.text: Why should we? All you human do is take and destroy with no care for others. We don't need your help. You've done enough damage.

roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.player: Well I admit that I've made a few mistakes, but my intentions were good, I swear.

roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.speaker: Islwyn
roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.text: Maybe, but it's not a risk worth taking. It was the acts of humans that led my grandmother's death. You will bring similar ruin to us.

roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.speaker: Islwyn
roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.text: Glarial, wife to King Baxtorian. At one time my grandparents ruled over a great elven kingdom. But your kind put an end to that.

roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.player: Glarial? I know that name, I visited her tomb. I moved her remains to Baxtorian Falls, I thought that was where she would want to be.

roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.speaker: Islwyn
roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.text: You... you moved her into the waterfall? That... that's the perfect place for her to be.

roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.speaker: Eluned
roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.text: Maybe this human isn't as bad as you think Islwyn.

roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.speaker: Islwyn
roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-or-eluned.text: Very well human, we will take you to Arianwyn. But first, there is something you must do. If my grandmother has been moved, then her new tomb must be consecrated. Do this, and you will earn my trust.

steps.player: Deal, what do I need to do?

steps.speaker: Islwyn
steps.text: I don't know the consecration process myself. You should speak to Eluned. She is wise in the ways of the ritual.

steps.player: Will do.
I'd rather not.

steps.speaker: Islwyn
steps.text: If you wish to see Arianwyn, this is the only way. Come find us if you change your mind.

roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-again.player: So what do you need to do?

roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-again.speaker: Islwyn
roving-elves-talking-to-islwyn-again.text: I don't know the consecration process myself. You should speak to Eluned. She is wise in the ways of the ritual.

roving-elves-talking-to-ilfeen.player: Not bad, I'm trying to help an elf named Islwyn consecrate his grandmother's resting place. Do you know of anything that could help me?

roving-elves-talking-to-ilfeen.speaker: Ilfeen
roving-elves-talking-to-ilfeen.text: Sorry, I know nothing of the consecration process. Eluned will know though, she travels with Islwyn.
If The Eyes of Glouphrie has been completed:

steps.player: Also, while I'm here, I have a question for you.

steps.speaker: Ilfeen
steps.text: Well ask away.

steps.player: Do you remember Oaknock? He was a gnome inventor.

steps.speaker: Ilfeen
steps.text: Of course! How is the young gnome? I rather liked him he was rather loud, but he had a good soul, and was very interested in elven magic.

steps.player: I think Oaknock died of old age some time ago. He must have visited you a few hundred years ago though...

steps.speaker: Ilfeen
steps.text: I keep forgetting, a hundred years is a long time for you. He was very interested in illusion magic, and how to prevent it. I gave him some advice and a few bits of equipment to help him.

steps.player: A seed?

steps.speaker: Ilfeen
steps.text: Of course. It grew into an axe. I hope he found it useful.

steps.player: I think he did! Thanks.

steps.text: Ilfeen smiles serenely.

consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned.player: Hey there, Islwyn said you might be able to help me. He told me you'd know how to consecrate ground for an elven burial. I need to consecrate Glarial's new resting place.

consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned.speaker: Eluned
consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned.text: That I do. It is elvish tradition to plant a specially enchanted crystal seed at the graves of our ancestors. The seed will create guardians to protect the area.

consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned.speaker: Eluned
consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned.text: Unfortunately, the crystal seed must be tuned to the person it's protecting, a new seed won't do. But you should be able to recover the seed from her old tomb.

consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned.speaker: Eluned
consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned.text: I'm not very familiar with the lands to the east so I couldn't tell you where her old tomb is I'm afraid.

consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned.player: That's okay, I've been there before. It's just south east of Baxtorian Falls.

consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned.speaker: Eluned
consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned.text: Excellent. Now, the tomb's guardians will be protecting the seed, you'll need to defeat one of them to get it. Once you have it, return to me and I will re-enchant it.

consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned.player: Okay, I'll be back as soon as I have it.

consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned-.speaker: Eluned
consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned-.text: Hello, any luck finding the consecration seed?

consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned-.speaker: Eluned
consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned-.text: You should be able to find it in her old resting place, I think you said it was south east of Baxtorian Falls. You'll need to defeat one of the old tomb's guardians to obtain it.

consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned-.speaker: Eluned
consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned-.text: Bring it to me as soon as you find it, then I can re-enchant it.

consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-eluned-.player: Okay, I'll see what I can do.

consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-islwyn-.speaker: Islwyn
consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-islwyn-.text: Good day. Have you spoken to Eluned yet?

consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-islwyn-.player: Yes, she told me to retrieve a crystal seed from Glarial's old tomb.

consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-islwyn-.speaker: Islwyn
consecrating-the-tomb-talking-to-islwyn-.text: Well I wish I could help but my kind have no place in the east any more.

enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-islwyn-wi.speaker: Islwyn
enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-islwyn-wi.text: Good day. Have you spoken to Eluned yet?

enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-islwyn-wi.player: Yes, she told me to retrieve a crystal seed from Glarial's old tomb. I have it right here.

enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-islwyn-wi.speaker: Islwyn
enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-islwyn-wi.text: Good, you should go and show it to her.

enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-eluned-wi.speaker: Eluned
enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-eluned-wi.text: Hello, any luck finding the consecration seed?
You hand the crystal seed to Eluned.

enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-eluned-wi.player: How odd. I can see her lips moving... But there's no sound.

enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-eluned-wi.text: Eluned hands you an enchanted crystal seed.

enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-eluned-wi.speaker: Eluned
enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-eluned-wi.text: Plant this seed in Glarial's new tomb, close to her remains. With it in place, she will rest in peace.

enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-eluned-wi.speaker: Eluned
enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-eluned-wi.text: Hey, how's it going? Have you managed to reconsecrate Glarial's resting place?

enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-eluned-wi.speaker: Eluned
enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-eluned-wi.text: Well when you're ready, plant the seed in Glarial's new tomb, close to her remains. With it in place, she will rest in peace.

enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-eluned-af.player: Hello, I lost the crystal seed.

enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-eluned-af.speaker: Eluned
enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-eluned-af.text: Not to worry, now I know the harmonic of Glarial's crystal, I can reproduce another one.
Eluned hands you another enchanted crystal seed.

enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-islwyn-af.speaker: Islwyn
enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-islwyn-af.text: Good day. I hear you managed to retrieve the crystal seed.

enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-islwyn-af.player: Indeed I did, all I need to do now is plant it in her new resting place.

enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-islwyn-af.speaker: Islwyn
enchanting-the-seed-talking-to-islwyn-af.text: This is good to hear. It put me at ease to know she is in my grandfather's home. I will rest even easier once it has been consecrated.

rest-in-peace-planting-the-seed-trying-t.text: You need a spade to be able to plant the seed.
This seed may only be planted close to Glarial's remains.

rest-in-peace-planting-the-seed-planting.text: You dig a small hole with your spade.
You drop the crystal seed in the hole.

rest-in-peace-talking-to-eluned.speaker: Eluned
rest-in-peace-talking-to-eluned.text: Hey, how's it going? Have you managed to reconsecrate Glarial's resting place?

rest-in-peace-talking-to-eluned.speaker: Eluned
rest-in-peace-talking-to-eluned.text: Well done. You should let Islwyn know.

rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.speaker: Islwyn
rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.text: You have returned! Is it done?

rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.player: It is, your grandmother's resting place has been consecrated.

rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.speaker: Islwyn
rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.text: Thank you, I admit I was wrong about you. You have showed care and compassion that I didn't think possible for a human. As promised, we will take you to Arianwyn. But first, a reward for you.
Islwyn shows you a crystal bow and a crystal shield.

rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.speaker: Islwyn
rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.text: We elves use equipment formed out of crystal itself, far superior to your human weapons. However, the crystal does degrade with use and will eventually revert to seed.

rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.speaker: Islwyn
rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.text: Both the shield and bow I am carrying have been used, so are not at their full potential. They should still be quite useful though.

rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.player: Fascinating. What do you mean by 'revert to seed'?

rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.speaker: Islwyn
rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.text: All elven crystal starts as a seed. It can then be sung into various shapes through the power of the voice. Eventually, it reverts back to seed, ready for the next song.

rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.speaker: Islwyn
rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.text: Keep an eye out for an elf named Ilfeen as you wander the forest. She can chant crystal seeds into new items for you.

rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.speaker: Islwyn
rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.text: Anyway, I'm sure you will learn more about crystal seeds as you spend time with our kind. For now though, which one of these creations would you like?

options.text: Shields are for wimps! Give me the bow!

steps.player: Shields are for wimps! Give me the bow!

steps.speaker: Islwyn
steps.text: All right. If you ever need a replacement I can sell you another. Remember, the better the condition of crystal equipment, the more potential it has.
If the player doesn't have enough inventory space:
Islwyn tries to give you a crystal bow but you don't have enough room for it.

options.text: I don't like running and hiding behind mushrooms. Shield please!

steps.player: I don't like running and hiding behind mushrooms. Shield please!

steps.text: All right. If you ever need a replacement I can sell you another. Remember, the better the condition of crystal equipment, the more potential it has.

Islwyn tries to give you a crystal shield but you don't have enough room for it.

options.text: I need some time to decide.

steps.player: I need some time to decide.

steps.speaker: Islwyn
steps.text: Very well. Come find me when you are ready.

rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.speaker: Islwyn
rest-in-peace-talking-to-islwyn.text: Now, let us know when you are ready to be taken to Arianwyn.

post-quest-talking-to-eluned.speaker: Eluned

steps.player: I'm ready.

post-quest-talking-to-ilfeen-for-the-fir.text: Hey, you're the human that helped my friend Islwyn, aren't you? He told me that he'd given you some crystal equipment.

post-quest-talking-to-ilfeen-for-the-fir.speaker: Ilfeen
post-quest-talking-to-ilfeen-for-the-fir.text: When it reverts to seed, bring it to me and I'll chant it for you.

vhvjdU.speaker: Islwyn
